Chosen rational threshold comparisons in MicroAttentionPulse.is_within_half_life (3 to 5) and LearningCheckMetrics.meets_certification_standards (9/10, 17/20, 4/5) evaluated on hardcoded Fraction fixtures.

claims.statement: The guide includes an exact executable worksheet and the quiz has 24 four-point problems across eight instructional levels

Quiz structure in quiz.md declaring eight instructional levels (Level 0 through Level 7) with three contiguous problems per level (24 problems, 4 points each, 96 points total).

claims.statement: A left inverse implies injectivity but not conservative extension of a theory.
dependencies: Set-theoretic left-inverse identity d(u(a)) = a for all a in A implying u(a) = u(a') => a = d(u(a)) = d(u(a')) = a'.
Explicit deductive theories T_A = (L_A, R_A) and T_B = (L_B, R_B) with u : L_A -> L_B and d o u = id_{L_A} where R_B derives an old-language proposition phi in L_A not derivable in T_A.
Specified Boolean valuation semantics when evaluating model-theoretic conservativity alongside proof-theoretic consequence reflection.
claims.limits: Semantic conservativity claims require explicitly declared interpretations and inference rules; complements PAPER008-SINGLETON-LEFT-INVERSE without constructing MSS context maps above stage 1.

claims.statement: Eight-wide integer opcode blocks for stages at least 22 are disjoint.
dependencies: Proposal opcode base formula b(N) = 128 + 8(N - 22) for integer stages N >= 22 with 8-wide intervals [b(N), b(N) + 8).
Source opcode namespace bound < 128 (SOURCE_OPCODE_SET subset of [0, 45] in pfp/domain/tower/registry.py).
Unbounded Python int arithmetic; fixed-width w-bit unsigned wire formats require the separate upper bound b(N) + 7 < 2^w.
claims.limits: Loaded catalog spans stages 0 through 100; 8-bit unsigned wire encodings overflow at stage 38 (b(38) + 7 = 263 >= 256); integer namespace disjointness does not construct stage semantics.
